ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — elevated error rate calling Cloud KMS Sign/Unwrap APIs in us-west1. 5m error rate ~15%. Paging on-call.

mara (oncall): taking the lead. paging @devon (sre) and @laila (eng-runtime). Katie, any customer noise?

katie (support): got 9 tickets in the last 20m, several reporting model startup timeouts and 500s. two customers are asking to be paged.

devon (sre): i'm seeing consistent 502/504s from kms.googleapis.com and kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com. TLS OK, then long server-side processing or 5xx. Startup handlers that unwrap DEKs are blocking for ~25-40s then error.

laila (eng-runtime): startup workflow currently blocks on KMS Unwrap, which causes the init path to return 500. We only have a cached DEK for warm pods; cold starts are affected.

piotr (security): we need to ensure any fallback preserves key confidentiality. Policy: cached plaintext DEKs allowed only if previous unwrap audit exists and cache_age < 900s. Document it in audit logs.

mara (oncall): mitigation brainstorm — (1) fast-fail startup unwraps so orchestrator replaces pods (less stuck pods, more churn), (2) allow cached DEK fallback on startup when audit+TTL checks pass, (3) deploy a lightweight signing proxy sidecar to serve per-request signing from cache while KMS is slow. Which to prioritize?

devon (sre): prioritize 2 + 3. 2 is a small runtime change; 3 is an ops deploy. We'll keep retries minimal to avoid pile-up on KMS.

laila (eng-runtime): implementing flag RUNTIME_KMS_STARTUP_FALLBACK=true. Behavior: on startup unwrap timeout -> if cache.hit && cache.audit && cache.age < 900 -> use cached DEK and continue; else exit fast and mark unhealthy. Adding audit event for fallback. Patch ready for canary.

mara (oncall): deploy plan: canary 10% new pods in us-west1 with fallback=true + signing-proxy for those pods. Monitor for 20m, then expand to 50% if stable.

devon (sre): deploying canary now.

Commands run:
```
kubectl set env deployment/runtime-usw1 RUNTIME_KMS_STARTUP_FALLBACK=true -n runtime-usw1-canary
kubectl apply -f manifests/signing-proxy-usw1-canary.yaml -n runtime-usw1-canary
```

katie (support): status page updated: "Investigating Cloud KMS latency affecting model startups and signing in us-west1. Mitigations being rolled out." Customers notified.

provider-bot: Provider ticket opened at 2026-03-15T14:07:00Z. GCP reports partial KMS degradation in us-west1; AWS reports elevated Sign 5xx in us-west-2. Engineers investigating.

piotr (security): audit event must include customer_id and key_id when fallback used. No wrapped DEKs should be written to disk. Confirm in runtime code.

laila (eng-runtime): added audit snippet on fallback:
```
AUDIT: runtime.kms.fallback startup=true instance=pod-abc123 customer=acct-987 key=projects/.../keys/... reason=kms_timeout cache_age=421
```
Also added guard to keep cached DEK only in memory.

devon (sre): canary results after 12m: startup failures in canary decreased from ~8/min to ~1.5/min. signing-proxy traffic shows fallback_sign_rate down to 0.6% vs 7.8% baseline. Good signal.

mara (oncall): expand to 40% for 10m, then full region if metrics hold. Keep provider ticket open and request ETA.

katie (support): customers updated with "rolling mitigations over the next 30-60m; provider investigation ongoing." Two enterprise accounts requested an incident contact.

provider-bot: Provider update at 2026-03-15T14:31:00Z: GCP KMS experienced internal throttling in us-west1; mitigations in progress. AWS still reporting elevated errors in us-west-2.

devon (sre): rolling to 100% in us-west1 at 14:36 UTC. Watch metrics: runtime.startup.failure_rate, kms.sign.latency_p95, runtime.signing.fallback_rate, signing_proxy.requests_per_min.

piotr (security): request for post-incident deliverables: timeline with per-customer fallback events, confirmation no plaintext DEKs persisted to disk, audit logs exported to compliance.

mara (oncall): handing off remaining window to devon. Documented actions in incident doc: https://internal.redwood/incidents/1900000000. Severity set to Sev2 during mitigation; downgraded to Monitoring at 15:05 UTC as errors trended down.

last_message: devon (sre): final note — keep signing-proxy toggle and startup-fallback config as runbook items. Plan follow-ups: (A) formalize secure cold-start unwrap fallback using local HSM/Kek; (B) tune client-side KMS timeouts/retries; (C) RCA with provider once stable. I'll draft the postmortem and share by EOD."
